title: Love the cube sizes, but very hard to remove them!
text: Love the cube sizes, but very hard to remove them!. Love-Hate relationship! :-) I LOVE the size of these large cubes, and the molds are easy to fill, but I HATE the difficulty in getting the cubes out! I found that filling the compartments up 1/2 way makes it a tad easier, but I bought this 'cuz I wanted the large full-sized cubes!

product_metadata.title: Samuelworld Large Silicone Ice Cube Tray Molds, 2-Pack, Big 2 Inch Cubes - Food Grade, Flexible, 8 Cavity Easy Release Slow Melting Ice for Whiskey, Cocktails, Gifts & Christmas - Black
features: EASE OF USE: Create 16 perfectly symmetrical giant ice cubes with absolute ease. Samuelworld's 2-pack large ice cube molds are designed to fit perfectly in most whiskey glasses, instantly adds class, sophistication, and elevates your drinks experience! If you prefer a version with lids, we do offer that as a separate option too. Please also expect the individual ice cubes produced to differ ever so slightly in size.

AMAZING VALUE FOR MONEY: Samuelworld's premium range of large 2-inch ice cube trays are constructed from high quality, BPA free material that is extremely durable. The carefully-designed food-grade silicone molds offers great portability, form perfect squared large ice cubes, while retaining the flexibility to pop the giant ice cubes easily from the trays. Alternatively, simply place the trays under running water for a brief moment to an even easier extraction.

PROFESSIONALS' PREFERED CHOICE: Enjoy the simplicity of creating awesome ice cubes today, just like the professionals. Samuelworld's premium range of ice cube trays are designed to consistently craft perfect large ice cubes everytime, proven to melt slower, slows down the dilution process, so that you and your guests enjoy the true flavours of your favourite beverage for longer. While these large ice cubes fit most whiskey glasses, we still suggest measuring the diameter of your favorite glasses first!

100% SAFE & SUPER EASY TO CLEAN: Simply rinse or chuck Samuelworld's ice trays into the dishwasher, and they are ready for use again. Only the very best of materials that resists odors and stays free from contamiants are used with every tray produced, perfect for use with whiskey, bourbon, gin, tequlia, cocktails, and so much more!

THE PERFECT NOVELTY GIFT: Looking for timeless novelty gifts? Samuelworld's Ice Trays are used by professional bartenders all around the world, and would be the perfect addition to any home bar, birthdays, housewarming, and even door gifts at events. Your family, friends, and guests will definitely love these amazing ice trays!
